summary: Linux desktop launcher routed Orca GUI starts through the CLI shim, causing repeated AppImage activation helpers while a live Electron singleton owner existed; fix launcher Exec to direct AppImage path and clean orphaned activate/update helpers after closing Orca.
details: See docs/reference/linux-appimage-single-instance-focus-loop.md. Do not remove ~/.config/orca/Singleton* while the target Orca PID is alive.
